self.created = True

evidence.reason: The acquire path fsyncs the token file but never fsyncs the marker's parent directory after O_CREAT, so the directory entry can be lost on power loss even though the code treats marker persistence as meaningful. That can drop the admission hold despite the file fsync; the release unlink has the same missing directory sync. This is a routine crash-consistency repair, not a new requirement.
